phases.name: Pipeline Track Core
phases.description: Replace disconnected dot pipeline with solid continuous track per ADR-004

steps.name: Replace IdeaPipelineStage with PipelineTrackSegment
steps.description: Replace the disconnected circle+label component with a track-segment+marker+label component. PipelineTrackSegment renders: a colored track bar segment (reached) or gray (future), a circular marker ON the bar (filled for reached, outlined for future, pulsing for current, red for rejected), and a label. STAGE_MARKER_COLORS constant migrates from idea-pipeline-stage.tsx. Framer Motion entrance animation on marker fade-in.
acceptance_criteria: AC-P2: Reached stages show colored track segment and filled colored marker
AC-P3: Current stage marker shows a pulse ring animation
AC-P4: Future stages show gray track segment and gray-outlined marker
AC-P8: REJECTED renders red marker at rejection point, gray beyond
AC-P7: Animation respects prefers-reduced-motion
AC-P12: All visible strings from locale files (Statuses.* namespace)
deliverables: Component tests for all 4 visual states + animation
quality_gates: All 4 visual states tested (reached, current, future, rejected)
steps.implementation_notes: Client component (use client). Uses motion/react for entrance animation on markers. STAGE_MARKER_COLORS copied from idea-pipeline-stage.tsx (with addition of 'future' gray). Stage labels from useTranslations('Statuses'). Track segment is a div with h-2 bg-{color} (reached) or h-2 bg-gray-200 (future). Marker is a span h-4 w-4 rounded-full positioned absolutely ON the track bar.

steps.name: Replace IdeaPipeline with PipelineTrack
steps.description: Replace the disconnected dots+connectors component with a single continuous track bar component. PipelineTrack renders: one continuous horizontal bar (gray base), colored overlay segments for reached stages (from PipelineTrackSegment), markers positioned ON the bar. Entrance animation: track fills left-to-right (motion.div scaleX 0->1), markers fade in with stagger delay. Vertical mode on mobile (isMobile prop). StalledIndicator below with fullWidth=true. Consumes PipelineStage[] unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: AC-P1: Track renders as a single continuous bar with 7 stage markers positioned on the bar
AC-P5: Stage labels alternate above/below on desktop; all one side on vertical mobile
AC-P6: On mount, track fills left-to-right and markers fade in sequentially
AC-P9: StalledIndicator renders below the track, spanning full track width
AC-P11: On mobile (isMobile=true), track renders vertically with markers along a vertical bar
AC-P13: computePipelineStages() and pipeline-stages.ts remain unchanged
steps.scenario_name: PipelineTrack renders continuous bar with all stages
quality_gates: Pipeline renders all 7 stages as continuous bar
Entrance animation works with prefers-reduced-motion fallback
steps.implementation_notes: Client component. Key DOM structure: outer div with relative positioning -> gray base bar (h-2 w-full bg-gray-200) -> colored overlay segments (absolute positioned, h-2, civic colors) -> markers (absolute positioned on bar). For vertical: flex-col, bar rotates to h-full w-2. Entrance: motion.div on the colored overlay with initial={{scaleX:0}} animate={{scaleX:1}} transition={{duration:0.6}} transformOrigin='left'. Markers: motion.div with stagger delay 0.05s per index. StalledIndicator: add fullWidth?: boolean prop, when true set w-full.

steps.name: Replace MiniPipeline with MiniPipelineTrack
steps.description: Replace the disconnected 3-dot mini pipeline with a compact solid track with 3 milestone markers. Same visual metaphor as PipelineTrack but thinner (h-1 bar, h-2.5 markers) and always horizontal. Same milestone grouping as ADR-003 (Submitted/In Voting/Completed). REJECTED ideas return null (no mini-pipeline). Horizontal only (used in idea cards).
acceptance_criteria: AC-M1: Renders a thin horizontal bar with 3 circular milestone markers
AC-M2: Reached milestones show colored marker; current milestone marker pulses
AC-M3: Future milestones show gray marker with gray-outlined ring
AC-M4: Milestone labels appear below markers
AC-M5: REJECTED ideas render no mini-pipeline track (return empty)
AC-M6: Same 3-milestone grouping as ADR-003
AC-M7: All visible strings from locale files (MiniPipeline.* namespace)
deliverables: Component tests for all milestone states
quality_gates: Renders 3 milestones correctly for all statuses
steps.implementation_notes: Client component. MILESTONES constant and milestone grouping logic migrate from mini-pipeline.tsx. DOM: gray base bar (h-1 w-full bg-gray-200) + colored segments (h-1, milestone colors) + 3 markers (h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full). Labels below markers in text-[10px]. Current milestone gets ring highlight. Uses pipeline-stages.ts getStageIndex(). No entrance animation for mini version (card component, not detail view).

steps.name: Migrate consumers and delete old components
steps.description: Update all import sites from IdeaPipeline/IdeaPipelineStage/MiniPipeline to PipelineTrack/PipelineTrackSegment/MiniPipelineTrack. Delete old component files and their test files. Update idea detail page, idea-card, and idea-list-row. Run full test suite to verify no regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Idea detail page imports and renders PipelineTrack instead of IdeaPipeline
IdeaCard and IdeaListRow import and render MiniPipelineTrack instead of MiniPipeline
Old component files deleted: idea-pipeline.tsx, idea-pipeline-stage.tsx, mini-pipeline.tsx
Old test files deleted: idea-pipeline.test.tsx, idea-pipeline-stage.test.tsx, mini-pipeline.test.tsx
Full test suite passes
TypeScript compiles without errors
steps.scenario_name: PipelineTrack renders continuous bar with all stages
quality_gates: No remaining imports of old component names
No dead code from old components
steps.implementation_notes: Search codebase for all imports of IdeaPipeline, IdeaPipelineStage, MiniPipeline. Replace with PipelineTrack, PipelineTrackSegment, MiniPipelineTrack. Props should be compatible (same shape). Verify: grep -r 'idea-pipeline' src/ should only find pipeline-track files (via path), not old imports. After migration, delete old files and their tests.
